visual_review.notes: All clips from the first H3 takes. The punch turns from the three-quarter wind-up to the side-on strike, as painted, in two smeared frames (video 30-31); they are cut and the contact lands on the first clean strike frame (32). Ranged keeps the chest-aperture glow the painted ranged poses carry; the smeared frame where the arms fly open (40) is cut. Defend skips a white flare on the chest the prompt did not ask for (video 14-33), so the colossus snaps from its stance into the crossed-arm guard. Death skips the smeared topple (82-86) where the matte leaves olive fringes. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
